meta.name: writing-great-skills
meta.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写和编辑高质量技能文档
copy.tagline_en: Write and edit high-quality skill documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are creating or improving a skill and need best practices.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照技能编写原则工作：优先保证可预测性，使用“引导词”锚定行为，按信息层级组织内容，并避免重复、过时、无操作等常见问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或编辑技能（SKILL.md 文件）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个技能，用于代码审查。
say.note: Claude 会应用技能编写原则来构建该技能。

say.text: 检查这个技能的描述是否包含重复的触发词。
say.note: Claude 会检查并指出重复的触发分支。

say.text: 这个技能有“提前完成”的风险吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析完成标准是否明确。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows skill-writing principles: prioritize predictability, use leading words to anchor behavior, organize content by information hierarchy, and avoid duplication, sediment, no-ops, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or edit a skill (SKILL.md file).

say_en.text: Write a skill for code review.
say_en.note: Claude applies skill-writing principles to build it.

say_en.text: Check if this skill's description has duplicate triggers.
Does this skill risk premature completion?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes if completion criteria are clear.
